name: skill-builder
description: Turn repeatable tasks into AI skills, review existing skills, and make informed skill-design choices.

interface.longDescription: Turn a repeatable task into a reusable AI skill, review an existing skill, or ask a question about skill design. Create guides the agent from examples and requirements to a candidate skill and evaluation plan. Audit produces evidence-linked findings, coverage limits, and prioritized next steps. Explain answers design questions using the complete preserved knowledge base. Agent judgment completes the work; helper output alone does not certify usefulness, safety, or readiness to publish. The full workflow requires a desktop environment with local files and execution tools; helper requirements and current host evidence are documented in the repository. Codex is the primary target. Other adapters and historical trials retain their evidence limits; no public OpenAI directory approval is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Create a portable skill that turns bug reports into QA test plans.

review.commerce_description: This skills-only package has no publisher purchases, payment processing, or required publisher-paid service. Host subscriptions and user-authorized external tools are separate.

publication.release_notes: First stable public release of Skill Builder, including standalone and OpenAI plugin packages, preserved source evidence, and explicit host compatibility limits.
